definitions.explanation: The visible vapor released from burning material.

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}で{目|め}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: My eyes hurt from the smoke.

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っている。
{工場|こうじょう}から{煙|けむり}が{出|で}ていた。
examples.english: Smoke was coming from the factory.

examples.japanese: {火事|かじ}の{煙|けむり}が{空|そら}に{広|ひろ}がり、{遠|とお}くからでも{見|み}えた。
examples.english: The smoke from the fire spread across the sky and could be seen from far away.

notes:
{煙|けむり} is the visible vapor produced by burning materials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {煙|けむり}が{出|で}る: smoke comes out
- {煙|けむり}が{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る: smoke rises
- {煙|けむり}を{吸|す}う: to inhale smoke
- {煙|けむり}に{巻|ま}く: to confuse, evade (idiom)

TYPES OF SMOKE:
- タバコの{煙|けむり}: cigarette smoke
- {排気|はいき}ガス: exhaust fumes
- {煙霧|えんむ}: smoky haze

RELATED WORDS:
- {煙突|えんとつ}: chimney
- {煙|けむ}い: smoky (i-adjective)
- {煙|けむ}たい: smoky; annoying (figurative)

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {煙|けむり} can also be read as けむ in compounds like {煙|けむ}たがる (to find someone bothersome).
